fieldValues.title: Run the CLI
fieldValues.line: Install the srs engine with one line (the [engine site](https://engine.semanticops.com) covers other platforms), unpack the sample, then check it and look around.
fieldValues.command:
curl -fsSL https://engine.semanticops.com/install.sh | sh
srs archive unpack meeting.srs --target meeting
srs repo validate --repo meeting
srs repo map --repo meeting
